title: Daily digest: Vande Mataram completes 151 years, Murmu | MLA, farmers greet CM with paddy sapling | Spread message that investing in Andhra  | Italian Foreign Minister says pro-Russia
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Vande Mataram completes 151 years, Murmu greets citizens.
MLA, farmers greet CM with paddy sapling portrait on birthday.
Spread message that investing in Andhra Pradesh is safe and effortless.
Italian Foreign Minister says pro-Russian hackers targeted him over Ukraine support.
bullets_ur: Vande Mataram ke 151 saal mukammal, Murmu ne shehriyon ko mubarakbaad di
MLA aur kisaanon ne CM ko salgirah par dhan ke podon ka portrait pesh kiya
Yeh paigham phelayein ke Andhra Pradesh mein sarmaya-kari mehfuz aur aasan hai.
Italy ke Wazir-e-Kharija ka kehna hai ke Russia-nawaz hackers ne Ukraine ki himayat par unhein nishana banaya
